clips.title: The story
paras: Along Lake Al'Ameth, blight spreads from a corrupted timberling called Oakenscowl. Denalan asks you to end the threat. The maddened creature dwells in a cave on the lake's southern bank.

Timberlings tend the boughs of Teldrassil, and Oakenscowl once led them. Now corruption runs through the world tree, reaching humble wildlife and ancient protectors alike. A massive growth swells across Oakenscowl's bark, driving the timberling mad. Where it once guarded the forest, blight now takes hold.

Oakenscowl hides in a cavern on Lake Al'Ameth's southern shore. Its presence poisons the nearby water and woodland beasts. Denalan cannot face the creature alone, so he seeks its destruction to cut off the corruption and study the strange growth afflicting the lake's spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In a cave along the southern bank of the lake, a timberling named Oakenscowl is spreading corruption to all the creatures that make Lake Al'Ameth their home.
I dared not get too close, but even from a distance, it is obvious: Oakenscowl is being poisoned by the largest tumor I have ever seen... I would call it gargantuan, even.
Friend, you have already done much to aid my efforts, but I ask of you one more task. Hunt down Oakenscowl and collect the tumor; remove this source of corruption from my home.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you located Oakenscowl yet, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew you were more than capable of ridding the lake of that horrible beast.
It is a distressing situation; Oakenscowl was once a grand leader amongst his kind... But corruption does not discriminate between the lowly and the noble.
The size of this tumor is quite disturbing, but I must study it to learn more about the disease that upsets the timberling population.
